articles.title: Cosmic Neighbor Gets a Major Upgrade: Super-Earth GJ 3378b Is More Earth-Like Than We Thought
articles.summary: A planet just 25 light-years away was thought to be a mini gas giant. New data shrinks its mass to 2.3 Earths, making it almost certainly rocky and potentially habitable. It orbits in the habitable zone of a red dwarf star.

articles.title: Minions & Monsters' Scares Up #1 Spot, But Franchise Faces Soft Opening
articles.summary: Universal's 'Minions & Monsters' earned $16M on Friday, leading the box office. The 1920s-set animated sequel is projected for a $39.5M domestic weekend, a modest start for the billion-dollar franchise. 'Toy Story 5' holds strong at #2.

articles.title: Morrowind Meets Final Fantasy 11 in Two Nostalgic Mods That Bridge the Decades
articles.summary: Two mods for 'The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind' reskin its interface to evoke 'Final Fantasy 11,' the 2002 MMO. Both games share a methodical, exploration-heavy design. The mods are available on Nexus Mods for OpenMW users.
